Problem: सतत विकास के सामाजिक, आर्थिक और पर्यावरणीय आयामों की अविभाज्यता पर जोर देते हुए, सतत विकास के लक्ष्यों में वैश्विक, राष्ट्रीय और स्थानीय स्तरों पर समावेशी नीतियों और प्रथाओं की वकालत की गई है। अपनी गैर-बाध्यकारी प्रकृति के बावजूद, सतत विकास लक्ष्यों ने वैश्विक बहसों, नीतिगत एजेंडा और संस्थागत प्राथमिकताओं को प्रभावित किया है, हालांकि परिवर्तनकारी परिवर्तन सीमित हैं। 2030 तक इन महत्वाकांक्षी लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने के लिए सहयोगी वित्तपोषण, तकनीकी नवाचार और मजबूत वैश्विक भागीदारी महत्वपूर्ण हैं।
Solution:
सतत विकास के एजेंडे 2030 को लोगों, ग्रह और समृद्धि के लिए एक व्यापक कार्य योजना के रूप में संदर्भित किया जाता है। यह सतत विकास के तीन स्तंभों सामाजिक, पर्यावरणीय और आर्थिक से सीधे संबंधित है। यह 17 लक्ष्यों, 168 लक्ष्यों और प्रगति को मापने के लिए 230 से अधिक संकेतकों से बना है। लक्ष्य सभी के लिए बेहतर और अधिक टिकाऊ भविष्य प्राप्त करने का खाका हैं। वे गरीबी, असमानता, जलवायु परिवर्तन, पर्यावरणीय गिरावट, शांति और न्याय सहित हमारे सामने आने वाली वैश्विक चुनौतियों का समाधान करते हैं।
 
 पिछले कुछ साल पूरी दुनिया के लिए बुरे सपने की तरह थे। खास तौर पर कोविड-19 हमारे लिए समाज के कंकालों में दरारों को उजागर करने वाले एक्स-रे की तरह रहा है। इसने हमें एहसास दिलाया है कि हम जिस रास्ते पर चल रहे थे, वह हमें कहीं नहीं ले जा रहा है, हमें अपना रास्ता बदलना होगा। अगर एक बात पक्की है तो वह यह है कि हमें अभी कार्रवाई करने की जरूरत है और विंस्टन चर्चिल ने एक बार कहा था, "कभी भी किसी संकट को व्यर्थ न जाने दें" और यह 2030 के एजेंडे पर भी लागू होता है। हमें अभी तुरंत कार्रवाई करने की जरूरत है।

summarization: The submission highlights the challenges in achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) by 2030, noting that while they influence global policy, transformative progress is limited. The proposed solution emphasizes the 2030 Agenda as a comprehensive framework to address global issues like poverty and climate change. It argues that the COVID-19 pandemic serves as a critical wake-up call, necessitating immediate and collaborative action to reshape our future.

Problem: हमारे घर के बगल के एक व्यक्ति जिनका पुत्र बाहर में काम कर कुछ धनराशि अपने बहन की शादी के लिए अपने पिता को ऑनलाइन भेजा। परंतु उनके पिता से साइबर फ्रॉड ने सारी धनराशि निकालना लीं।
Solution:
ऑनलाइन सुरक्षा के लिए सुझाव
 1. अनजाने लिंक पर क्लिक न करें: अज्ञात स्रोतों से आए ईमेल या संदेशों में दिए गए लिंक पर क्लिक करने से बचें। ये लिंक आपके डिवाइस में मैलवेयर डाल सकते हैं या आपकी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी चोरी कर सकते हैं।
 2. व्यक्तिगत जानकारी साझा न करें: अपनी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी, जैसे कि आपका बैंक खाता नंबर, क्रेडिट कार्ड नंबर, या पासवर्ड, किसी के साथ भी साझा न करें।
 3. सुरक्षित वेबसाइटों का उपयोग करें: ऑनलाइन लेनदेन करते समय, सुनिश्चित करें कि आप एक सुरक्षित वेबसाइट पर हैं। वेबसाइट के URL में "https" और एक ताला की छवि देखें।
 4. पासवर्ड को मजबूत रखें: अपने ऑनलाइन खातों के लिए मजबूत और अनोखे पासवर्ड का उपयोग करें। अपने पासवर्ड को नियमित रूप से बदलना भी एक अच्छा विचार है।
 5. ऑनलाइन लेनदेन की निगरानी करें: अपने बैंक खातों और क्रेडिट कार्ड खातों की निगरानी करें और किसी भी अनहोनी या असामान्य गतिविधि की सूचना तुरंत अपने बैंक या क्रेडिट कार्ड कंपनी को दें।
problem_translated: A person living next to our house had his son, who works outside, send money online to his father for his sister's wedding. However, a cyber fraudster managed to withdraw all the money from his father's account.
solution_translated: Suggestions for online safety: 1. Do not click on unknown links: Avoid clicking on links provided in emails or messages from unknown sources. These links can install malware on your device or steal your personal information. 2. Do not share personal information: Do not share your personal information, such as your bank account number, credit card number, or password, with anyone. 3. Use secure websites: When making online transactions, ensure that you are on a secure website. Look for 'https' and a padlock icon in the website's URL. 4. Keep passwords strong: Use strong and unique passwords for your online accounts. It is also a good idea to change your passwords regularly. 5. Monitor online transactions: Monitor your bank and credit card accounts and report any suspicious or unusual activity to your bank or credit card company immediately.
summarization: The student addresses the issue of cyber fraud, specifically highlighting a case where a family lost money intended for a wedding. The proposed solution provides a comprehensive guide on online safety, including tips on avoiding suspicious links, protecting personal data, using secure websites, creating strong passwords, and monitoring financial transactions.

problem_translated: Network Issues: 1. We face network-related problems in most remote areas. 2. In rural areas, BSNL towers are mostly installed which operate on 2G, making it difficult to watch videos properly. 3. In some sensitive areas, network problems persist due to the issue of Naxalism. Problem: दृष्टिहीन व्यक्तियों के लिए चश्मा का विकास एक महत्वपूर्ण तकनीकी कदम है । जिसमें अल्ट्रासोनिक सेंसर का उपयोग किया जा रहा है । यह चश्मा उन्हें अपने आस - पास की वस्तुओं का सही आकलन करने में मदद करता है खासकर उन परिस्थितियों में जहां दृष्टि की कमी होती है । अल्ट्रासोनिक सेंसर की मदद से यह चश्मा ध्वनि तरंगों का उपयोग करके वातावरण को समझता है और उपयोगकर्ता को रियल - टाइम से वस्तुओं की स्थिति और दूरी के बारे में सूचित करता है । अल्ट्रासोनिक सेंसर उच्च आवृत्ति वाली ध्वनि तरंगों का उपयोग करते हैं जब यह तरंगे किसी वस्तु से टकराती है तो वह वापस लौट आती है और सेंसर इसे मापता है यह जानकारी उपयोगकर्ता को विभिन्न प्रकार से दी जा सकती है जैसे वाइब्रेशन , ध्वनि संकेत या दोनों के संयोजन के माध्यम से ।
Solution: अंधे लोगों के लिए चश्मा बनाने में अल्ट्रासोनिक सेंसर का उपयोग एक उन्नत समाधान हो सकता है । यह चश्मा अल्ट्रासोनिक और इन्फ्रारेड तकनीकों का मिश्रण कर सकता है जिससे उपयोगकर्ता को आस - पास की वस्तुओं की जानकारी मिल सके । अल्ट्रासोनिक सेंसर से उपयोगकर्ता को आवाज या वाइब्रेशन के माध्यम से सूचित करती है । यह चश्मा अंधे लोगों के लिए बेहद फायदेमंद हो सकती है , क्योंकि इससे उन्हें आस - पास के अवरोधों जैसे दीवारों , स्टूल , टेबल्स या चलती गाड़ियों से अवगत कराता है । इसके अलावा यह उन्हें सड़कों पर चलने गंतव्य तक पहुंचाने और रास्ते में आने वाली बाधाओ से बचने में मदद करती है।
problem_translated: The development of glasses for visually impaired individuals is a significant technological step. It uses ultrasonic sensors to help them accurately assess their surroundings, especially in situations where vision is limited. With the help of ultrasonic sensors, these glasses understand the environment using sound waves and inform the user about the position and distance of objects in real-time. Ultrasonic sensors use high-frequency sound waves; when these waves hit an object, they bounce back, and the sensor measures this. This information can be provided to the user in various ways, such as through vibration, sound signals, or a combination of both.
solution_translated: Using ultrasonic sensors to create glasses for blind individuals can be an advanced solution. These glasses can combine ultrasonic and infrared technologies to provide the user with information about nearby objects. The ultrasonic sensor notifies the user through sound or vibration. These glasses can be extremely beneficial for blind people as they make them aware of obstacles in their surroundings such as walls, stools, tables, or moving vehicles. Furthermore, it helps them walk on roads, reach their destinations, and avoid obstacles encountered along the way.
summarization: This project proposes smart glasses for the visually impaired that utilize ultrasonic and infrared sensors to detect surrounding obstacles. By converting distance data into real-time sound or vibration alerts, the device helps users navigate their environment safely and avoid collisions with objects or vehicles.

problem_translated: We have observed in our surroundings that water in the storage tank becomes hot during the summer and cold during the winter due to extreme temperatures.
solution_translated: By wrapping jute sacks around the water tank and applying a coating of lime water (calcium hydroxide) and mud over them, the water temperature will neither rise nor fall significantly, keeping the temperature of the tank water stable.
summarization: The student addresses the issue of water temperature fluctuations in storage tanks due to extreme seasonal weather. The proposed solution involves insulating the tank with jute sacks coated in a mixture of lime water and mud to maintain a stable water temperature throughout the year.

Problem: எங்கள் ஊரில் இந்த பிரச்சனை உள்ளது.
Solution:
ஒரு வீடு அல்லது வங்கிகளிள் அதிகமாக திருட்டு நடக்கிறது இதற்கு என்ன தீர்வு ?
  
 ஒரு விட்டில் திருட்டு நடப்பதை காவல்துறைக்கு "sensor" முலமாக தானாகவே தெரிவிக்கும் ஒரு யோசனை ஆகும். 
 ஒரு "laser" முலமாக "LDR"மிது laser படும்படி இருக்கு. அப்படி laserபடவிள்ளை என்றாள் காவல்துறைக்கு அபாய ஒலி கேட்கும். இப்பொளுது திருடன் வீட்டிற்குள் சென்று அந்த laser ldr மிது படாமல் திருடன் மிதுபடும் அதனால் காவல்துறைக்கு அபாய ஒலி கேட்கும். அதன் பின்னர் காவல்துறை அதிகாரிகள் திருடனை பிடித்து செல்வர்.
 வீடுகள் மற்றும் வங்கிகளிலும் அனைத்து இடங்களிளும் இருக்க வேண்டும்.
problem_translated: This problem exists in our town.
solution_translated: What is the solution for the high frequency of thefts occurring in homes or banks? The idea is to use a sensor to automatically notify the police when a theft occurs in a house. A laser is positioned so that it hits an LDR (Light Dependent Resistor). If the laser is interrupted, an alarm will sound for the police. When a thief enters the house, they will block the laser from hitting the LDR, which will trigger the alarm for the police. Consequently, police officers can catch the thief. This system should be implemented in homes, banks, and all other locations.
summarization: The student proposes a security system to prevent thefts in homes and banks. The solution uses a laser and LDR sensor setup that triggers an automatic alarm to the police whenever the laser beam is interrupted by an intruder. This aims to provide real-time notification to law enforcement to help catch thieves.

Problem: உங்களின் பாதுகாப்பு கண்காணிப்பு திறன்கள் மற்றும் சம்பவ பதிலளிப்பு நடைமுறைகளின் செயல்திறனை மதிப்பிட உதவும் அச்சுறுத்தல் நுண்ணறிவு-உந்துதல் எதிரி உருவகப்படுத்துதல்

 கிளவுட் பாதுகாப்பு: தரவு, பயன்பாடுகள் மற்றும் உள்கட்டமைப்புகள் உள்ளிட்ட கிளவுட் அடிப்படையிலான அமைப்புகளைப் பாதுகாக்கிறது.

problem_translated: Threat intelligence-driven adversary simulation to help evaluate the effectiveness of your security monitoring capabilities and incident response procedures.
solution_translated: Cybersecurity is the practice of protecting internet-connected devices and services from cyberattacks. It involves using technologies, processes, and controls to reduce the risk of cyberattacks and the unauthorized exploitation of systems, networks, and technologies. Cybersecurity protects against: phishing schemes, ransomware attacks, identity theft, data breaches, and financial losses. Some types of cybersecurity include: Network security: Protects the integrity and confidentiality of data transmitted across networks. This includes firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and Virtual Private Networks (VPNs). Cloud security: Protects cloud-based systems, including data, applications, and infrastructure. Application security: Keeps software and devices free from threats.
summarization: The student proposes using threat intelligence-driven adversary simulations to test and improve security monitoring and incident response. The solution explains the importance of cybersecurity in protecting against various digital threats and outlines key areas such as network, cloud, and application security.

Problem: ഏഴാം തരത്തിലെ ശാസ്ത്ര പുസ്തകത്തിലെ ഒന്നാമത്തെ യൂണിറ്റായ വിളയിക്കാം നൂറുമേനി എന്ന പാഠഭാഗത്തിലെ കാർഷീക വിളകൾ എങ്ങനെ മെച്ചപ്പെടുത്താം എന്ന ചർച്ചയിലാണ് ഇത്തരമൊരു പ്രൊജക്ട് ചെയ്യാനുള്ള പ്രേരണയായത്.കാവുകളിൽ മരങ്ങൾ വളങ്ങളൊന്നും ചേർക്കാതെ തന്നെ നല്ല രീതിയിൽ വളരുന്നു. നമ്മുടെ വീടുകളിലും മരങ്ങൾ വളർത്തിയാൽ കൂടുതൽ ഫലം കിട്ടും . കാവുകളുടെ തനത് സ്വഭാവം തൊടിയിലുള്ള സസ്യജാലങ്ങളിൽ പ്രയോഗിച്ചാൽ ആരോഗ്യമുള്ള ചെടികൾ വളർത്തിയെടുത്ത് മെച്ചപ്പെട്ട വിളകൾ വർധിപ്പിക്കാം.തെങ്ങ് മുതലായ സസ്യങ്ങൾക്ക് തടമെടുത്ത് വളം ചേർക്കുമ്പോൾ അവയുടെ വേരുകൾക്ക് ക്ഷതമേൽക്കുന്നു . അതിനാൽ അ വളപ്രയോഗം സസ്യങ്ങൾക്ക് മുഴുവനും ലഭിക്കുന്നില്ല . അതുകൊണ്ട് വിളവ് കുറയുന്നു. കാവുകളിൽ വേരുകൾ മുറിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുള്ള വളപ്രയോഗം നടക്കുന്നില്ല . അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്താൽ നാട്ടിൻ പുറങ്ങളിലെ സസ്യങ്ങളിൽ നല്ല രീതിയിൽ ഉൽപാദനം ഉണ്ടാക്കാൻ കഴിയും .
Solution: കാവുകളെപ്പോലെ നാട്ടിൻ പുറങ്ങളിലെ വൃക്ഷങ്ങളിൽ പുതയിടൽ സമ്പ്രദായം നടപ്പിലാക്കിയാൽ കൂടുതൽ വിളവ് ലഭിക്കും . ജാപ്പാനീസ് മാതൃകയായ ' മിയോ വാക്കി ' വനവൽക്കരണ പദ്ധതി പ്രകാരം ചുരുങ്ങിയ സ്ഥലത്ത് വനവൽക്കരണ പദ്ധതി നടപ്പിലാക്കാം.മണ്ണിന്റെ ഈർപ്പം സംരക്ഷിക്കാൻ മണ്ണിൻറെ ഫലഭൂയിഷ്ഠ തയും ആരോഗ്യവും മെച്ചപ്പെടുത്തൽ കളകളുടെ വളർച്ച കുറയ്ക്കൽ എന്നിവ പുതിയത് കൊണ്ടുള്ള പ്രയോജനമാണെന്ന് കൃഷി ഓഫീസറിൽ നിന്നും അഭിമുഖത്തിലൂടെ മനസ്സിലാക്കാൻ സാധിച്ചു. കാവ് സംരക്ഷണം , വനസംരക്ഷണം എന്നിവയുടെ പ്രാധാന്യം ജനങ്ങളിലേക്ക് എത്തിക്കാൻ ബോധവൽക്കരണ ക്ലാസുകൾ സംഘടിപ്പിച്ചു.
problem_translated: The inspiration for this project came from a discussion on how to improve agricultural crops, based on the first unit 'Vilayikkam Noorumeni' (Let's Harvest a Hundredfold) in the 7th-grade science textbook. Trees in sacred groves (Kavukal) grow well without the addition of any fertilizers. If we grow trees in our homes in a similar way, we can get better yields. By applying the natural characteristics of sacred groves to the plants in our backyards, we can grow healthy plants and increase crop yields. When we dig basins around plants like coconut trees to add fertilizer, their roots get damaged. As a result, the fertilizer is not fully absorbed by the plants, leading to lower yields. In sacred groves, there is no such fertilization process that involves cutting roots. If we adopt this approach, we can achieve better production from plants in rural areas.
solution_translated: If the mulching method used in sacred groves is implemented for trees in rural areas, higher yields can be obtained. Following the Japanese 'Miyawaki' afforestation model, afforestation projects can be implemented in small spaces. Through an interview with the Agricultural Officer, it was understood that the benefits of mulching include preserving soil moisture, improving soil fertility and health, and reducing weed growth. Awareness classes were organized to convey the importance of protecting sacred groves and forests to the public.
summarization: This project proposes adopting the natural, root-friendly mulching techniques found in sacred groves to improve crop yields in home gardens and rural areas, avoiding the root damage caused by traditional basin-digging fertilization. Additionally, the student suggests implementing the 'Miyawaki' afforestation model to maximize plant growth in small spaces and conducted awareness programs to promote forest and grove conservation.

Problem: ഭൂകീഴ്പ്പുകൾ (Landslides) പ്രകൃതി ദുരന്തങ്ങളിൽ ഒരേതാണ്, ഇത് മനുഷ്യജീവിതത്തിന്, പ്രാപർട്ടിക്ക് വലിയ തകർച്ചകൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്നു. ഇത്തരം ദുരന്തങ്ങൾ മുൻകൂട്ടി പ്രവചിക്കാൻ വളരെ പ്രയാസമാണ്. എന്നാൽ, അർദ്വിനോ (Arduino UNO) ഉപയോഗിച്ച് സെൻസറുകൾ, പ്രത്യേകിച്ച് വൈബ്രേഷൻ സെൻസർ (vibration sensor) മണ്ണിന്റെ ജലാംശം (soil moisture) സെൻസർ, ഉപയോഗിച്ച് ഭൂകീഴ്പ്പ് സാധ്യതകൾ തിരിച്ചറിയാനും GSM മൊഡ്യൂൾ വഴി SMS മുന്നറിയിപ്പ് അയയ്ക്കാനും ഒരു സംവിധാനത്തിന്റെ രൂപകൽപ്പന ചെയ്യുന്നത് ഈ പദ്ധതിയുടെ ലക്ഷ്യമാണ്. ഇത് ഭൂകീഴ്പ്പുകൾക്ക് മുമ്പ് മുന്നറിയിപ്പ് നൽകാൻ സഹായകമായിരിക്കും, ഒപ്പം പ്രാദേശിക എമർജൻസി പ്രാധാന്യങ്ങൾക്കും ഉയർന്ന സുരക്ഷയും ലഭ്യമാക്കും.
Solution:
ഞങ്ങളുടെ കണ്ടെത്തിയ പരിഹാരം Arduino UNO അടിസ്ഥാനമാക്കി ഒരു ഭൂകീഴ്പ്പ് മുന്നറിയിപ്പ് സിസ്റ്റം ആണ്. ഇത് GSM മൊഡ്യൂൾ, വൈബ്രേഷൻ സെൻസർ, മണ്ണിന്റെ ജലശേഷി സെൻസർ എന്നിവ ഉപയോഗിച്ച് പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നു.
 പ്രവർത്തന രീതി:
 വൈബ്രേഷൻ സെൻസർ ഭൂകീഴ്പ്പുകളുടെ അടയാളങ്ങൾ കണ്ടെത്തുന്നു, Arduino UNO ഇക്കാര്യങ്ങൾ പ്രോസസ്സ് ചെയ്ത്.

problem_translated: Landslides are a type of natural disaster that cause significant destruction to human life and property. It is very difficult to predict such disasters in advance. However, the goal of this project is to design a system using Arduino UNO along with sensors, specifically a vibration sensor and a soil moisture sensor, to identify the potential for landslides and send warning SMS alerts via a GSM module. This will be helpful in providing warnings before landslides occur and will also provide high security for local emergency priorities.
solution_translated: Our proposed solution is a landslide warning system based on Arduino UNO. It works using a GSM module, a vibration sensor, and a soil moisture sensor. Method of operation: The vibration sensor detects signs of landslides, and the Arduino UNO processes this information. The soil moisture sensor detects the moisture content of the soil, and the GSM module sends an SMS. Who it helps: Local communities: If landslide possibilities are known in advance, people can move to safer places. Emergency services: Rescue workers receive real-time messages and can take swift action. Benefits of the solution: Early detection of landslides and avoidance of losses. Safety for local communities and faster operational capacity for emergency services.
summarization: This project proposes an Arduino-based landslide early warning system that utilizes vibration and soil moisture sensors to detect potential landslide conditions. When triggered, the system uses a GSM module to send SMS alerts to local communities and emergency services. This solution aims to minimize loss of life and property by enabling timely evacuation and faster emergency response.

problem_translated: A new model for organic waste management in schools is needed. The methods currently in use are not fully effective. There are issues with maggots and rat infestations.
solution_translated: Set up a kitchen garden. Prepare four or five pits of 30cm x 30cm x 30cm size between the saplings in the garden. Deposit the daily organic waste in a net box raised above the ground level in the garden. The next day, deposit the waste into the pit and cover it with a 2cm layer of soil. Once one pit is full, move to the next. When all the pits are full, use the organic fertilizer from the first pit for the plants and repeat the process.
summarization: The student proposes a systematic organic waste management solution for schools to address issues like pests and ineffective disposal. By using a series of small, soil-covered pits in a kitchen garden, the waste is converted into organic fertilizer for the plants, ensuring a clean and productive waste management cycle.

Problem:
The "Bus Safety System: Protecting Kids & Pedestrians" is an innovative solution designed to enhance safety around buses, particularly for children and other pedestrians who might be at risk when a bus is stationary. This system addresses a critical safety issue: when a bus is stopped, children or pedestrians may walk in front of the bus, potentially putting themselves in danger if the driver cannot see them. Our system utilizes simple yet effective technology to prevent such accidents and ensure a safer environment.
 Problem Statement
 When a bus stops, especially in areas where visibility is limited, children might walk in front of the bus without the driver's knowledge. This can lead to dangerous situations where the bus might accidentally move forward, potentially causing accidents. To address this problem, a reliable and responsive safety system is needed to alert both the driver and the pedestrians.
Solution: Our solution is the "Bus Safety System: Protecting Kids & Pedestrians," which aims to enhance safety around stationary buses. It uses IR sensors mounted at the front of the bus to detect the presence of pedestrians. When a pedestrian is detected, the system activates a buzzer and a red visual light to alert the driver. Simultaneously, a playback module announces a pre-recorded message, "Please move away from the front of the bus," to notify pedestrians. Additionally, the system integrates with the bus’s control to prevent movement if a pedestrian is detected. This solution helps children, pedestrians, and drivers by providing clear, immediate alerts and preventing accidents. It ensures that pedestrians are aware of their proximity to the bus and prevents the bus from moving until the area is clear, thereby addressing visibility issues and enhancing overall safety.

Problem:
Hydroponic farming can face a number of challenges, including: 
 High setup cost: Setting up a hydroponic system can be expensive, especially for large-scale systems. 
 Constant power supply: Hydroponic systems need electricity to run continuously. 
 Maintenance and monitoring: Growers need to be vigilant to avoid component failure. 
 Common problems: Some common problems include wilting, dead roots, system clogging, infestation, and nutrient deficiencies
Solution:
Problem: Wilting
 
 It can be due to several factors such as less irrigation or high temperature, where the plant loses its rigidity, and leaves start drying.in our project automatic mobile controlled drip irrigation is used.this is managed from our house and controled thousands of hydroponic plants in one time .
 
  
 
 Solution: You should let your roots dry between each irrigation cycle. A backup pump should always be handy if the operating one gets fail because the plants can wilt quickly without water supply.
 
  
 
 Problem: Dead Roots
 
 There are many reasons for dead roots like high temperature of water, very high or very low EC, overwatering in dense substrates, and others. Dead roots can also be a sign of root rot pathogen infecting the system.

Problem: Our school is facing drinking water scarcity since long.. Tape water is not available in the school.our school manages water by buckets or by tankers.. The Village in which school is located has been divided into three habitations or Mohlas Dodder Mohala,Khoja Mohlas And Raja Mohlas.. Due this problem the inhabitants of the School habitation and School itself suffers a lot.
Solution: The village have about 10 natural water springs excreting pure crystal clear water continuously.The water flows 24×7 and gets wasted due to miss management.If that water is collected in a well constructed water bowl at spring site,then lifted through water pump and supplied to the school and inhabitants of school habitation.. water crisis in the school and school habitation will resolve for ever in the area.
problem_translated: Our school has been facing a drinking water shortage for a long time. Tap water is not available in the school, and we manage our water needs using buckets or tankers. The village where the school is located is divided into three habitations or mohallas: Dodder Mohalla, Khoja Mohalla, and Raja Mohalla. The school is located in Raja Mohalla, which is at a higher altitude compared to the other two habitations. While the other two habitations receive a frequent supply of tap water, the school's habitation does not receive enough water to meet the school's requirements. Due to this, the residents of this habitation and the school itself suffer significantly.
solution_translated: The village has about 10 natural water springs that provide a continuous flow of pure, crystal-clear water. This water flows 24/7 and is currently wasted due to mismanagement. If this water were collected in a well-constructed water tank at the spring site and then lifted using a water pump to be supplied to the school and the residents of the school's habitation, the water crisis in the school and the area would be resolved permanently.
summarization: The school and its surrounding habitation suffer from a chronic water shortage because they are located at a higher altitude than other parts of the village. The student proposes utilizing the wasted water from 10 nearby natural springs by collecting it in tanks and pumping it to the school and the local community to provide a sustainable water supply.

problem_translated: The lack of efficient and reliable systems for watering plants can lead to either overwatering or underwatering, which adversely affects plant health, growth, and yield. While moisture sensors powered by solar panels offer a solution, challenges in their implementation can limit their effectiveness and reliability. Reliance on traditional irrigation methods often leads to inefficient water use in agriculture and horticulture, resulting in plants receiving too much or too little water. Although solar-powered moisture sensors provide a promising solution to automate watering based on real-time soil moisture levels, many challenges hinder their effectiveness. These challenges include inconsistent solar energy supply, calibration issues, technical failures, and a lack of user understanding. Consequently, this leads to poor plant health, resource wastage, economic losses, and environmental degradation. There is a dire need to enhance reliability and efficiency.
solution_translated: The proposed solution is an integrated solar-powered moisture sensor irrigation system that automates the watering process based on real-time soil moisture levels. This system combines advanced moisture sensors, efficient solar panels, and smart irrigation techniques to ensure optimal plant hydration while minimizing resource wastage. How it works: 1. Moisture Sensors: - Installation: Moisture sensors are placed at various depths in the soil to accurately measure moisture content. 2. Solar Power Supply: - Solar Panels: High-efficiency solar panels power the moisture sensors and the irrigation system. They are positioned to maximize exposure to sunlight, ensuring reliable energy production. - Energy Storage: A rechargeable battery stores excess energy generated during the day to power the system during cloudy weather or at night. 3. Data Processing and Irrigation Control. 4. User Interface. Who it helps: 1. Farmers and agricultural workers. 2. Gardeners and horticultural experts. 3. Cities.
summarization: The project addresses the inefficiency of traditional irrigation, which often leads to improper plant hydration and resource waste. The student proposes an automated, solar-powered irrigation system that uses soil moisture sensors to deliver water only when needed. This solution aims to improve plant health and conserve water for farmers, gardeners, and urban environments.

problem_translated: In the city, many people cross traffic signals without waiting for the signal, which leads to a risk of accidents. To address this, we have created a smart traffic system that allows only one signal to pass at a time, after which the other signals remain closed, significantly reducing the possibility of accidents.
solution_translated: In the smart traffic system, if the signal is on one side, it automatically closes all other paths using gates, so no vehicle rider can cross the road without a signal. This can greatly reduce accidents at signals because vehicles can only pass from one side, which makes the possibility of collisions very low. This can reduce road accidents and minimize the loss of human life. It is very beneficial for people, especially for those who drive vehicles. This is an idea for our project which we have built as a prototype. It significantly reduces traffic-related accidents; this is the smart traffic system.
summarization: The student has identified the issue of people jumping traffic signals, which leads to frequent accidents. They have proposed a smart traffic system that uses automated gates to block other lanes while one side is active, ensuring that vehicles cannot cross illegally and thereby reducing the risk of collisions.

Problem:
औद्योगिक कार्यशालाओं में, आरा मशीनों का उपयोग आम तौर पर सामग्री काटने के लिए किया जाता है। हालाँकि, ये मशीनें ऑपरेटरों के लिए महत्वपूर्ण सुरक्षा जोखिम पैदा करती हैं, जिसमें आकस्मिक हाथ की चोट एक बड़ी चिंता का विषय है। आपातकालीन स्टॉप बटन या सुरक्षात्मक गार्ड जैसे पारंपरिक सुरक्षा तंत्र दुर्घटनाओं को रोकने के लिए पर्याप्त तेज़ी से प्रतिक्रिया नहीं कर सकते हैं।
 
 इस परियोजना का उद्देश्य एक *अल्ट्रासोनिक सेंसर* और *Arduino* का उपयोग करके एक *वास्तविक समय सुरक्षा प्रणाली* को डिज़ाइन और कार्यान्वित करना है। यदि कोई वस्तु (जैसे ऑपरेटर का हाथ) आरा ब्लेड के **30 सेमी* के भीतर आती है, तो सिस्टम स्वचालित रूप से आरा मशीन को रोक देगा, जिससे संभावित चोटों को रोका जा सकेगा। इसके अतिरिक्त, अतिरिक्त सुरक्षा के लिए एक *मैनुअल आपातकालीन स्टॉप बटन* एकीकृत किया जाएगा। मोटर केवल तभी संचालन फिर से शुरू करेगी जब वस्तु निर्दिष्ट सुरक्षा दूरी से आगे बढ़ जाएगी।1. ब्लेड के 30 सेमी के भीतर किसी वस्तु या हाथ का पता चलने पर आरा मोटर को रोककर दुर्घटनाओं को रोकें।
Solution:
हमारा समाधान एक *स्वचालित सुरक्षा प्रणाली* है जो ब्लेड के *30 सेमी* के भीतर किसी वस्तु या हाथ के आने पर आरा मोटर को रोक देती है। यह प्रणाली एक *अल्ट्रासोनिक सेंसर (HC-SR04), **Arduino UNO, और एक **रिले मॉड्यूल* का उपयोग करके बनाई गई है जो आरा ब्लेड का अनुकरण करने वाली 5V DC मोटर को नियंत्रित करती है। इसके अतिरिक्त, एक *आपातकालीन स्टॉप बटन* तत्काल शटडाउन के लिए मैन्युअल नियंत्रण प्रदान करता है।

problem_translated: In industrial workshops, saw machines are commonly used for cutting materials. However, these machines pose significant safety risks to operators, with accidental hand injuries being a major concern. Traditional safety mechanisms like emergency stop buttons or protective guards cannot react quickly enough to prevent accidents. The objective of this project is to design and implement a real-time safety system using an ultrasonic sensor and Arduino. If any object (such as an operator's hand) comes within 30 cm of the saw blade, the system will automatically stop the saw machine, thereby preventing potential injuries. Additionally, a manual emergency stop button will be integrated for extra safety. The motor will resume operation only when the object moves beyond the specified safety distance.
solution_translated: Our solution is an automatic safety system that stops the saw motor when an object or hand comes within 30 cm of the blade. This system is built using an ultrasonic sensor (HC-SR04), an Arduino UNO, and a relay module that controls a 5V DC motor simulating the saw blade. Additionally, an emergency stop button provides manual control for immediate shutdown. How the solution works: 1. Object Detection: If the operator's hand comes within 30 cm, the waves bounce back, and the Arduino calculates that if the distance is less than 30 cm, it triggers the relay module to turn the motor off. 2. Automatic Motor Control: If no hand is detected within 30 cm, the motor runs normally. 3. Emergency Stop Button. Who the solution helps: 1. Machine operators. 2. Workshop managers and supervisors. 3. Company owners. How the solution addresses the problem: Accident prevention, automatic control, minimal downtime, and improved safety.
summarization: This project addresses the risk of hand injuries in industrial saw machine operations by implementing an automated safety system. Using an ultrasonic sensor and an Arduino, the system detects if an object enters a 30 cm danger zone around the blade and automatically cuts power to the motor. This provides a faster, more reliable safety response than traditional manual methods, effectively protecting operators from accidental injury.

Problem: यदि कही किसी दुर्घटना से आग लग जाय और यदि इसका सही समय में समाधान न किया जाय तो यह भयंकर रूप धारण कर लेती है। यदि किसी जगह पर आग लग जाती है और हमे उसका पता नही है तो यह धीरे धीरे विशाल रूप धारण कर लेता है जहा आग लगा है उसके साथ आस पास का पूरा क्षेत्र बर्बाद हो जाता है।
Solution:
हमने इस समस्या के समाधान के लिए एक स्मार्ट डिवाइस जिसका नाम है फायर अलर्ट सिस्टम का निर्माण किया है। यह स्मार्ट उपकरण है यह जिस नंबर से कनेक्ट है उसे नंबर पर आग लग जाने पर मैसेज और कॉल करता है जिससे हमें पता चल जाता है आग लगी है और हम फायर ब्रिगेड के पास कॉल कर सकते हैं और इसे होने वाले भयंकर परिणाम को रोक सकते हैं।
 यह फायर या स्मोक को डिटेक्ट करता है उसके बाद अलर्ट सिग्नल भेजता है। हम दुनिया के किसी भी कोने पर होंगे हमे इसका मैसेज,कॉल प्राप्त होगा।
problem_translated: If a fire breaks out due to an accident and is not addressed in time, it can take on a dangerous form. If a fire starts somewhere and we are unaware of it, it gradually grows into a massive blaze, destroying not only the site of the fire but also the entire surrounding area.
solution_translated: To solve this problem, we have created a smart device called the 'Fire Alert System.' This is a smart device that sends a message and makes a call to the connected number when a fire occurs. This allows us to know that a fire has started so we can call the fire brigade and prevent severe consequences. It detects fire or smoke and then sends an alert signal. We will receive the message and call regardless of which corner of the world we are in.
summarization: The student has identified that undetected fires can cause widespread destruction. To address this, they developed a 'Fire Alert System' that detects smoke or fire and immediately notifies the user via calls and messages, allowing for timely intervention from anywhere in the world.

Problem: भूकंप एक प्राकृतिक आपदा है जो किसी भी समय और किसी भी स्थान पर आ सकती है।
Solution: भूकंप अलार्म भूकंप आने के समय बजने लगता है जिससे समय रहते लोग घरों से लोग सुरक्षित स्थान पर जा सकते हैं।
problem_translated: Earthquakes are a natural disaster that can occur at any time and in any place.
solution_translated: An earthquake alarm starts ringing at the time of an earthquake, allowing people to move to a safe place from their homes in time.
summarization: The student identifies earthquakes as unpredictable natural disasters. To address this, they propose an earthquake alarm system that alerts people immediately, enabling them to evacuate to safety before the situation worsens.

Problem: हमारे गांव में एक महिला अपने किचन में गैस में दूध चढ़ा कर चली चली गई थी तो हवा के कारण गैस के बजने से पूरे किचन में एलपीजी गैस फैल जाता है । फिर वह महिला वापस किचन में आती है तो उसने देखा कि गैस बुझ चुका था फिर उसने गैस जलाने के लिए लाइटर में क्लिक किया फिर वहां ब्लास्ट हुआ जिससे उस महिला के साथ दुर्घटना हो गई ।
Solution: यह गैस सेफ्टी डिवाइस गैस के रिसाव को सेंस करके रेगुलेटर को ऑफ करेगा और एक बजर बजेगा । जिससे अगर कोई व्यक्ति आसपास हो तो उसे पता चल जाएगा कि यहां गैस रिसाव हुआ है। जिससे दुर्घटना होने के संभावना कम हो जाएगी । यह किचन में काम करने वाले महिलाओं , वर्कर सभी के लिए उपयोगी है ।
problem_translated: In our village, a woman left milk on the gas stove in her kitchen and went away. Due to the wind, the gas flame went out, causing LPG to spread throughout the kitchen. When the woman returned to the kitchen and clicked her lighter to relight the stove, an explosion occurred, causing an accident.
solution_translated: This gas safety device will sense the gas leakage, turn off the regulator, and trigger a buzzer. This will alert anyone nearby that a gas leak has occurred, thereby reducing the chances of an accident. It is useful for women working in the kitchen and all other workers.
summarization: The student proposes a gas safety device to prevent accidents caused by accidental LPG leaks. The device detects leaks, automatically shuts off the gas regulator, and sounds an alarm to alert people, ensuring kitchen safety.

Problem: "टच इलेक्ट्रिक बोर्ड" एक प्रकार का इंटरएक्टिव बोर्ड है, जिसका उपयोग शिक्षा, कार्यस्थल, और अन्य इंटरएक्टिव उद्देश्यों के लिए किया जाता है। यह आमतौर पर एक डिजिटल डिस्प्ले के रूप में होता है, जिसे टचस्क्रीन तकनीक के माध्यम से नियंत्रित किया जा सकता है। इसमें किसी भी प्रकार के कंटेंट (जैसे कि टेक्स्ट, इमेज, वीडियो आदि) को प्रदर्शित किया जा सकता है और उसे टच स्क्रीन से इंटरैक्ट करके उपयोग किया जा सकता है। यह खासकर क्लासरूम, मीटिंग रूम, और कॉन्फ्रेंस में काम आता है।
Solution:
TOUCH ELECTRIC BOARD एक इंटरेक्टिव और स्मार्ट तकनीक है जो विद्युत उपकरणों के संचालन को टच स्क्रीन के माध्यम से नियंत्रित करने की सुविधा प्रदान करती है। इसका उद्देश्य पारंपरिक स्विच और कंट्रोल सिस्टम की जगह एक अधिक उन्नत, यूजर-फ्रेंडली, और स्मार्ट समाधान देना है। इलेक्ट्रिक बोर्ड में एक डिजिटल टच स्क्रीन होती है, जो उपयोगकर्ता को सीधे स्क्रीन पर टच करने के माध्यम से विभिन्न विद्युत उपकरणों को नियंत्रित करने की सुविधा देती है।विद्युत सर्किट से जुड़ी जानकारी को प्रोसेस करके सही आदेश भेजते हैं। जैसे ही आप स्क्रीन पर किसी बटन को टैप करते हैं, यह सिग्नल विद्युत सर्किट को मिलता है और संबंधित उपकरण सक्रिय या निष्क्रिय हो जाता है, मदद करता है-घरों में,ऑफिस और इंडस्ट्रियल सेटिंग्स में,विशेष आवश्यकताओं वाले व्यक्तियों के लिए,
 यह समस्या को सुलझाएगा-1कम्फर्ट और कंवीनियंस- किसी भी स्विच को ढूंढ़ने या हाथ से चलाने की जरूरत नहीं, बस टच करें और उपकरण चालू हो जाएगा। 2.स्मार्ट एनर्जी मैनेजमें3.रिमोट कंट्रोल 4.एक्सेसिबिलिटी
 इस तरह से एक स्मार्ट, सुविधाजनक, और ऊर्जा की बचत करनेकरने वाला समाधान है
problem_translated: A 'Touch Electric Board' is a type of interactive board used for education, workplaces, and other interactive purposes. It is typically a digital display that can be controlled via touchscreen technology. Any type of content (such as text, images, videos, etc.) can be displayed on it and interacted with using the touchscreen. It is particularly useful in classrooms, meeting rooms, and conferences.
solution_translated: The TOUCH ELECTRIC BOARD is an interactive and smart technology that provides the facility to control the operation of electrical appliances through a touchscreen. Its purpose is to provide a more advanced, user-friendly, and smart solution to replace traditional switches and control systems. The electric board features a digital touchscreen that allows the user to control various electrical appliances by touching the screen directly. It processes information connected to the electrical circuit and sends the correct commands. As soon as you tap a button on the screen, the signal reaches the electrical circuit, and the corresponding appliance is activated or deactivated. It helps in homes, offices, and industrial settings, and for individuals with special needs. It solves problems by providing: 1. Comfort and Convenience - No need to search for or manually operate switches; just touch, and the appliance turns on. 2. Smart Energy Management. 3. Remote Control. 4. Accessibility. In this way, it is a smart, convenient, and energy-saving solution.
summarization: The student proposes a 'Touch Electric Board' to replace traditional manual switches with a centralized, interactive touchscreen interface. This system allows users to control electrical appliances in homes, offices, and industrial settings through simple touch commands. The innovation aims to improve convenience, energy management, and accessibility for all users, including those with special needs.

Solution: ब्लैक ऑयल जो लोग वेस्ट समझ कर फेंक देते हैं उसका आदर्श ईंधन के रूप में उपयोग किया जा सकता है एवं जिसका ज्वलन ताप भी उच्च होता है इस ब्लैक तेल में मीथेन गैस प्रेजेंट रहती है जो एक आदर्श ईंधन के रूप में काम करती हैइसका उपयोग घर से लेकर उद्योगों तक चिकित्सा क्षेत्र अनुसंधान क्षेत्र वहां हर क्षेत्र में किया जा सकता है क्योंकि यह एक आदर्श ईंधन है इसलिए इसका उपयोग व्यापक स्तर पर किया जा सकता है यह हर तरीके से उत्तम ईंधन होता है
problem_translated: Due to the day-by-day increase in population, there has been a massive rise in means of transportation, which has led to an excessive increase in the use of petrol and diesel. The gases emitted from these are causing air pollution to rise continuously. In today's time, there is a need for an ideal fuel that produces minimal pollution. Such an ideal fuel can be produced from the black oil (waste oil) released from vehicles. When black oil burns, methane gas is released in the form of blue smoke. Methane is an important gas that can be used as fuel. Methane gas can be utilized in various sectors such as energy production, cooking gas, industrial use, vehicle propulsion, agriculture, medicine, and scientific research.
solution_translated: Black oil, which people consider waste and throw away, can be used as an ideal fuel, and it also has a high ignition temperature. This black oil contains methane gas, which acts as an ideal fuel. It can be used in every field, from homes to industries, the medical sector, and research areas. Because it is an ideal fuel, it can be used on a large scale. It is an excellent fuel in every way.
summarization: The student identifies the growing problem of air pollution caused by the excessive use of petrol and diesel in vehicles. They propose using 'black oil' (waste oil) as a sustainable alternative, as it releases methane gas—an efficient fuel source—when burned. This solution aims to repurpose waste into a versatile energy source for domestic, industrial, and scientific applications.

Problem: हमारे आसपास कचरे की समस्या बहुत होती है और कचरा सड़कों पर बिखरा होता है जिससे मलेरिया जैसी बीमारियां फैलती है
Solution: हम यह एक डस्टबिन की तरह ही है इसमें कचरा डालेंगे और वह डंडा डूबेगा और जिससे एक सिक्का बाहर निकलेगा और उसे सिक्के को लोग देखकर उसमें ज्यादा कचरा डालेंगे और जिस गांव क्लीन होगा और कचरा एकत्रित करने में सहायता मिलेगी इसलिए यह दो-तीन ऐसे ही गांव में लगा देंगे जिससे सभी लोग डालेंगे और कचरा करते तो होगा जिससे बीमारियां न मिलेगी यह कचरा विकिरण करने वाले लोगों को देंगे जिससे यह नई चीज बनाएंगे जिससे लोगों को काम आएगी
problem_translated: The problem of waste is very common around us, and garbage is scattered on the streets, which leads to the spread of diseases like malaria.
solution_translated: This is like a dustbin; when you put garbage into it, a lever will be triggered, and a coin will come out. Seeing this coin, people will be encouraged to put more garbage in it, which will help keep the village clean and assist in waste collection. We will install two or three such bins in the village so that everyone uses them, ensuring waste is collected and diseases are prevented. We will give this collected waste to recyclers who can create new useful items from it.
summarization: The student proposes an incentive-based waste collection system where a coin is dispensed as a reward for disposing of garbage in a special dustbin. This mechanism aims to encourage cleanliness in the village, reduce the spread of diseases, and facilitate the recycling of collected waste into new products.

Problem:
कामकाजी महिलाओं को घर की साफ सफाई में, पोछा लगाने में बहुत समय लगता है साथ ही आजकल के खान पान की वजह से और अन्य कारणों से भी महिलाओं को जोड़ों के दर्द आदि से परेशानी का सामना करना पड़ता है।
 घर की साफ सफाई में दिक्कत आती है।
Solution:
हमने घरेलू और कामकाजी महिलाओं की साफ सफाई की परेशानी को देखते हुए एक एसी मशीन बनाई है। जिससे महिलाओं को साफ़ सफ़ाई में समय की बचत होगी।
 साथ ही जीनको जोड़ो में दर्द है वो भी इसका उपयोग एक जगह बैठकर कर सकती हैं।
 इसके पोछा मारने के लिए बार बार पानी बदलने की जरूरत नही होती।
 इस मशीन में हमने पानी डालने का डिब्बा बना दिया है, और नीचे की तरफ पोछे का कपड़ा, साथ ही गंदे पानी को बाहर निकालने की व्यवस्था की है।
 
 साफ पानी एक अलग डिब्बे में डाला और एक डिब्बे में गंदा पानी निकलता रहेगा।
 साफ़ पानी पोछा लगे हुए डिब्बे में जाता रहेगा। और जब पोछा गंदा हो जाएगा तो उसको एक डिब्बे में निचोड़ लेगे जिससे पानी गंदा पानी एकत्रित करने वाले डिब्बे में इकट्ठा हो जाएगा। 
 यह मशीन रिमोट से चलेगी, जिसको एक जगह बैठकर चलाया जा सकेगा।
 इस प्रकार महिलाएं इस रिमोट की सहायता से एक जगह बैठकर पूछा लगा सकेगी।
 इसमें एक बार पानी डालना पड़ता है और मशीन को एक जगह रख कार कंट्रोल कर सकते हैं।
 इस प्रकार महिलाएं एक बार पानी डालकर एक रूम कर जगह बैठकर आराम से साफ सफाई कर सकती हैं।
 तथा अपने समय को भी बचा सकती हैं।
problem_translated: Working women spend a lot of time cleaning their homes and mopping floors. Additionally, due to modern dietary habits and other factors, many women face issues like joint pain, which makes household cleaning difficult.
solution_translated: Considering the cleaning challenges faced by homemakers and working women, we have designed a machine that saves time during cleaning. It can also be used by those suffering from joint pain while sitting in one place. There is no need to change the water repeatedly to mop the floor. We have included a water tank in the machine, a mopping cloth at the bottom, and a system to drain out dirty water. Clean water is poured into one container, while dirty water is collected in another. Clean water is continuously supplied to the mop area, and when the mop gets dirty, it can be squeezed into a compartment, with the dirty water flowing into the collection tank. This machine is remote-controlled, allowing users to operate it while sitting. By filling the water once, women can clean an entire room comfortably from one spot, thereby saving time.
summarization: The student has proposed a remote-controlled mopping machine designed to assist women, especially those with joint pain, in cleaning their homes without the need for manual labor or frequent water changes. The device features a dual-tank system for clean and dirty water and allows the user to mop an entire room while sitting in one place, effectively saving time and reducing physical strain.

Problem: विद्यालय में छुट्टियों में पेड़ पौधों का पानी की कमी से मुर्झा जाना तथा कभी तो पौधे पूरी तरह ही खतम हो जाते सुख कर।
Solution:
हमने विद्यालय में लगे पेड़ पौधों की अच्छी वृद्धि के लिए ऐसी तकनीक विकसित की है, जिससे पौधों की अच्छी वृद्धि होगी उनको पानी की समस्या से जूझना नहीं पड़ेगा।
 विद्यालय में लगे सभी छोटे पौधों और बड़ी पेड़ों को एक पाईप लाईन के माध्यम से विद्यालय में बनी टंकी या टांका जिसमे नल लगा हुआ है से जोड़ देगे। 
 नल से एक पाईप बड़ी लंबी पाईप लगाएंगे अब इस मुख्य पाईप से छोटी छोटी पाईप निकालेगे और प्रत्यक छोटी पाईप को विद्यालय में लगे पेड़ पौधों से जोड़ देंगे।
 अब नल में टूटी लगाएंगे ताकि टंकी का पानी उसमें आ सके।
 अब जब भी विद्यालय की लंबी छुट्टी होगी तो हम टूटी को धीमी बूंद बूंद पानी आए ऐसे चालू करके छोड़ देंगे।
 जिससे मुख्य पाईप में पानी जाता रहेगा और उसके माध्यम से छोटी पाईप में।
 छोटी पाईप से प्रेत्यक पेड़ और पोधे में जाता रहेगा।
 इस प्रकार छुट्टियों में भी सभी पौधे हरे भरे रहेंगे और उनकी अच्छी वृद्धि होती रहेगी।
 इस प्रकार इस तकनीक से हम पेड़ को सुरक्षित रख सकते हैं।
problem_translated: During school holidays, plants and trees wither due to a lack of water, and sometimes they dry up and die completely.
solution_translated: To ensure the healthy growth of plants in the school, we have developed a technique so that they do not have to face water scarcity. We will connect all the small plants and large trees in the school to the school's water tank or cistern (tanka) equipped with a tap using a pipeline. A long main pipe will be attached to the tap, and from this main pipe, smaller pipes will be extended to each plant and tree in the school. We will install a valve on the tap to control the water flow from the tank. During long school holidays, we will leave the tap open just enough for water to drip slowly. This will allow water to flow into the main pipe and then through the smaller pipes to each tree and plant. In this way, all the plants will remain green and continue to grow well even during the holidays. Using this technique, we can keep the trees safe.
summarization: The student identified that plants in school often die during long holidays due to a lack of water. To solve this, they proposed a simple drip irrigation system connected to the school's water tank, which can be set to provide a slow, steady supply of water to all plants while the school is closed.

Problem: ई-वेस्ट में वे सभी इलेक्ट्रॉनिक उपकरण शामिल होते हैं जिनको अब उपयोग में नहीं लिया जाता है। आज के डिजिटल युग में इलेक्ट्रॉनिक उपकरण हमारे जीवन का हिस्सा बन गए हैं स्मार्टफोन से लेकर लैपटॉप टेलीविजन से लेकर घरेलू उपकरणों तक हम सब में इलेक्ट्रॉनिक उपकरण का प्रयोग करते हैं। लेकिन जैसे-जैसे इन उपकरणों का उपयोग बढ़ रहा है वैसे-वैसे इनसे जुड़ी समस्याएं भी बढ़ रही है, जिनमें से एक प्रमुख समस्या है ई-वेस्ट।ई-वेस्ट यानी की इलेक्ट्रॉनिक कचरा, वे सभी इलेक्ट्रॉनिक उपकरण जिन्हें अब प्रयोग में नहीं लाया जाता या जो खराब हो चुके हैं । इनसे निकलने वाले खतरनाक रसायन के साथ यह मिट्टी में घुल जाते हैं और वातावरण को भी प्रदूषित करते हैं ई-वेस्ट का प्रबंध जैसी गंभीर समस्या के बारे में लोगों को जागरूक करना अति आवश्यक है।
Solution:
चाहे हम कार्यस्थल पर किसी तकनीकी समस्या को हल करने का प्रयास कर रहे हों, या किसी ऐसी बाधा को दूर करने का प्रयास कर रहे हों जिसे गूगल मैप्स नहीं देख पाता है - अधिकांश लोग हर दिन समस्या का समाधान कर रहे होते हैं । 
 
 लेकिन आप अपने जीवन में चुनौतियों से निपटने में कितने प्रभावी हैं ? क्या आपके पास कोई बुलेटप्रूफ प्रक्रिया है जिसका पालन करके आप ठोस परिणाम सुनिश्चित करते हैं, या... क्या आप अपनी गंभीर समस्याओं को हल करने के लिए प्रेरणा की सनक (या उसकी कमी) पर काम करते हैं?
problem_translated: E-waste includes all electronic devices that are no longer in use. In today's digital age, electronic devices have become a part of our lives, from smartphones to laptops and televisions to household appliances. However, as the use of these devices increases, the problems associated with them are also growing, one of the major problems being e-waste. E-waste, or electronic waste, refers to all electronic devices that are no longer used or have become faulty. The hazardous chemicals released from them dissolve into the soil and pollute the environment. It is extremely important to make people aware of the serious problem of e-waste management.
solution_translated: Whether we are trying to solve a technical problem at the workplace or trying to overcome an obstacle that Google Maps cannot see - most people are solving problems every day. But how effective are you at dealing with challenges in your life? Do you have a bulletproof process that you follow to ensure solid results, or... do you work on the whim of inspiration (or the lack thereof) to solve your serious problems?
summarization: The student identifies the growing environmental threat posed by improper disposal of electronic waste, which releases hazardous chemicals into the soil. While the problem statement highlights the need for public awareness, the solution section discusses the importance of having a structured, consistent process for problem-solving rather than relying on sporadic inspiration.

problem_translated: Usually, when we remove spider webs from the ceilings in our homes using a web remover stick, the debris falls into our eyes. It also falls on our skin, causing itching. Furthermore, our hands start to ache when we try to clean for a long time.
solution_translated: Women-friendly web remover stick. As we usually see, when we remove spider webs from ceilings in our homes using a web remover stick, the debris falls into our eyes. It also falls on our skin, causing itching. Furthermore, our hands start to ache when we try to clean for a long time. As a solution to this problem, we have created a women-friendly web remover stick. The web remover rotates with the help of a motor, and to prevent the falling debris from landing on us while it rotates, an umbrella has been placed in the middle. This umbrella collects the spider webs, ensuring they do not fall on us. This can be manufactured easily at a low cost and is easy to use.
summarization: The student has identified that using traditional web removers causes debris to fall on the user, leading to eye irritation, skin itching, and physical strain. To solve this, they designed a motorized web remover stick equipped with an umbrella-like attachment that catches the debris, preventing it from falling on the user while making the cleaning process easier and more comfortable.

Solution: సాధారణంగా పాఠశాలలో మా టీచర్లు బోర్డును తుడిసేటప్పుడు చాక్ పీస్ డస్ట్ ముందు వరుసలో కూర్చున్న విద్యార్థుల మీద,కళ్ళల్లో పడుతుంది. దీనివల్ల కళ్ళల్లో మంట అలాగే ఎలర్జీ వచ్చే అవకాశం ఉంది. దీనికి పరిష్కారంగా ఈ ప్రాజెక్టును తయారు చేయడం జరిగింది. ఒక స్టిక్ తీసుకొని దానికి ఒక చివర్ల డస్టర్ నుంచి,మధ్యలో ఆ డస్ట్ ను కలెక్ట్ చేసుకోవడానికి ఒక బాక్స్ నుంచడం జరిగింది. టీచర్స్ బోర్డును తుడుపేసేటప్పుడు ఆ డస్ట్ అంతా ఆ బాక్స్ లో పడుతుంది కాబట్టి విద్యార్థులకు ఇలాంటి ఇబ్బంది కలగదు.
problem_translated: Usually, when our teachers at school erase the board, chalk dust falls on the students sitting in the front row and gets into their eyes. This can cause eye irritation and potential allergies.
solution_translated: To solve this problem, this project was developed. A stick is used with a duster attached to one end, and a box is placed in the middle to collect the dust. When teachers erase the board, all the dust falls into the box, preventing any inconvenience to the students.
summarization: This project addresses the issue of chalk dust falling on students in the front row while teachers erase the blackboard. The student proposes a modified duster attached to a stick with an integrated collection box, which captures the dust during the erasing process to prevent eye irritation and allergies.

summarization: The student identifies the need for self-protection against various threats like wild animals and insects. The proposed solution focuses on methods or devices to help individuals escape or stay safe from these dangers.

Problem: సరుగుడు బొప్పాయి వంటి తోటలు వేసుకునే వాళ్ళు నారుని చిన్నచిన్న నల్లటి ప్లాస్టిక్ సంచుల్లో తెచ్చుకుంటారు అలాగే ఇళ్లల్లో కొన్ని రకాల పూల చెట్లు కానివ్వండి పండ్ల చెట్లు కానివ్వండి వేసుకోవాలనుకున్నప్పుడు కూడా వారు ఆ చెట్లని నల్లటి ప్లాస్టిక్ సంచుల్లో ఇవ్వడం అనేది మనం చూస్తుంటాం ఈ సంచులు తర్వాత ఉపయోగపడం రీసైకిలింగ్ చేయలేం అలాగే ఇవి అలాగే గనక పడేస్తే ప్లాస్టిక్ కాలుష్యం కింద భూమిని కలుషితం చేస్తాయి కనుక ఈ ఎక్కువ చెట్లని తెచ్చుకునేటువంటి రైతులు ఎక్కువగా ఈ ప్లాస్టిక్ కవర్లను ఉపయోగించటం అనేది నేను గమనించినటువంటి పెద్ద సమస్య ఇది భూ కాలుష్యానికి సంబంధించిన సమస్య ఇల్లా ఇళ్లల్లోనూ ఇది సమస్యగానే ఉంది తోటల్లోనూ ఇది సమస్యగానే నాకు కనిపించింది కాబట్టి దీని పరిష్కరించాలని చిన్న ప్రయత్నాన్ని చేయడం జరిగింది
Solution: రైతులు పండ్ల చెట్లు, నిమ్మనారు ఇలాంటివన్నీ తెచ్చుకునేటప్పుడు చిన్న చిన్న ప్లాస్టిక్ కవర్లలో వాళ్ళు నారుని తెచ్చుకుంటూ ఉంటారు. అది రీసైక్లింగ్ కి పనికిరాదు కాబట్టి వాళ్ళు ఆ ప్లాస్టిక్ ని బయటే పారేస్తారు. ప్లాస్టిక్ కాబట్టి అది నీటిని భూమిలోకి చేరనివ్వదు, ఆ ప్లాస్టిక్ భూమిలో కరిగిపోకుండా కొన్ని లక్షల సంవత్సరాలు భూమిలోపల ఉండి భూకాలుష్యంగా రూపాంతరం చెందుతుంది. దీని వల్ల మా చుట్టూ ప్రక్కల గ్రామాల ప్రజలు కష్టాలు ఎదుర్కోవాల్సిన పరిస్థితి వస్తుంది. కాబట్టి దానికి పరిష్కారం కనుక్కుందాము అన్న ఆలోచన నాకు వచ్చింది. దీన్ని మా టీచర్ గారు కూడా బాగుంది అన్నారు. నా ఆలోచన ఏంటంటే, గుళ్ళల్లో గాని ఇళ్ళల్లో గాని కావాల్సినన్ని టెంకాయ చిప్పలు దొరుకుతుంటాయి. వాటిల్లోని కొబ్బరిని వినియోగించిన తర్వాత ఆ ఆ కొబ్బరిచిప్పల్లో నారు నాటి మనము వాటిల్ని పెంచుకోవచ్చు. ప్లాస్టిక్ కవర్లను వాడేకన్నా ఈ కొబ్బరిచిప్పల్లో నారు నాటుకొని దాన్ని మొత్తాన్ని మనం భూమిలో నాటుకోవచ్చు లేదా మొక్క భూమిలో నాటేసిన తర్వాత ఆ చిప్పల్ని తిరిగి కొత్త నారు వేయటానికి ఉపయోగించుకోవచ్చు. ఇలా చేయడం వల్ల భూకాలుష్యాన్ని తగ్గించవచ్చు అని నా ఉద్దేశం.
problem_translated: Farmers who plant crops like Casuarina (Sarugudu) and Papaya bring seedlings in small black plastic bags. We also see this when people buy flower or fruit plants for their homes. These bags are not useful later, cannot be recycled, and if discarded, they cause plastic pollution and contaminate the soil. I have observed that the extensive use of these plastic covers by farmers is a major issue. This is a problem related to soil pollution that affects both farms and households.
solution_translated: When farmers bring seedlings for fruit trees or lemon plants in small plastic covers, they often discard the plastic because it cannot be recycled. Since plastic prevents water from seeping into the ground and does not decompose for millions of years, it leads to soil pollution, causing difficulties for people in our surrounding villages. I discussed this with my teacher, and they liked my idea. My solution is to use coconut shells, which are easily available in temples and homes. After using the coconut, we can plant seedlings inside these shells. Instead of using plastic covers, we can plant the seedlings in these coconut shells and then plant the entire shell into the ground, or reuse the shells for new seedlings after the plant is transplanted. My intention is to reduce soil pollution through this method.
summarization: The student identifies the widespread use of non-recyclable plastic bags for plant seedlings as a major cause of soil pollution in both farms and households. To address this, the student proposes using discarded coconut shells as biodegradable and sustainable alternatives for growing and transplanting seedlings, which helps prevent plastic waste and promotes eco-friendly gardening.

Problem: ఆరోగ్యం చూర్ణం అందరికీ ఆవశ్యకం
Solution: మా బృందం చాలామంది తో మాట్లాడి ఏదైనా పోషకవిలువలు గల పదార్ధాన్ని తయారుచేయాలని ఆలోచన చేసాము ఇందులో భాగంగా పెసలు,సెనగలు, బీన్స్ గింజలు, గోధుమలు, మెంతులు,అవిసె గింజలను మొలకెత్తింది నీడలో బాగా ఆరబెట్టాలి వీటితోపాటు ఉసిరికాయ ముక్కలను కూడా ఆరబెట్టి పూర్తిగా తేమ పోయేందుకు వేడిచేయాలి మిక్సీలో వేసి పౌడర్ చేయాలి దీనిని ప్రతిరోజూ అన్నంలో చెంచాడు పౌడర్, పావు చెంచా ఆవు నెయ్యి ‌కలిపి‌తినవచ్చు అన్నంతో తినలేమంటే కాస్త తేనె లో నానబెట్టి తినవచ్చు ఇది చౌకగా లభించే పౌష్టికాహారం వీటివలన విటమిన్లు A,C,EKమరియూ ఇనుము, పొటాషియం, మెగ్నీషియం లభిస్తాయి రోగనిరోధక శక్తి పెరుగుతుంది
problem_translated: Health powder is essential for everyone.
solution_translated: Our team spoke with many people and decided to create a nutritious substance. As part of this, we sprouted green gram, chickpeas, beans, wheat, fenugreek, and flax seeds, and dried them thoroughly in the shade. Along with these, we also dried gooseberry (amla) pieces and heated them to remove all moisture. We then ground them into a powder using a mixer. This can be consumed daily by mixing one spoonful of the powder with a quarter spoonful of cow ghee in rice. If one cannot eat it with rice, it can be soaked in a little honey and consumed. This is an affordable nutritious food that provides vitamins A, C, E, K, as well as iron, potassium, and magnesium, which helps boost immunity.
summarization: To address the need for affordable nutrition, the student team developed a nutrient-rich health powder made from sprouted grains, seeds, and dried gooseberries. This powder is a cost-effective supplement packed with essential vitamins and minerals, designed to be consumed daily with rice or honey to improve overall health and immunity.

Problem: పూర్వం ప్రజలు పిల్లలు ఒంటికి పసుపు రాసేవారు ఎందుకంటే పసుపు యాంటి బయాటిక్స్ మరియు శరీరానికి దురదలు రాకుండా చేస్తుంది.పసుపు అంటే మనం వాడే ప్యాకెట్ పసుపు కాదు వాళ్ళే పండించిన పసుపు కొమ్ములను బాగా దంచి తయారు చేసిన పసుపును రాసేవారు.కాని ఇప్పుడు బోడీ లోషన్స రాస్తున్నారు మరియు డైపర్స వాడుతున్నారు దీని కారణంగా రాషెస్ వస్తున్నాయి.
Solution: చిన్న పిల్లల ఒంటికి రాషెస్ రాకుండా చేయడం కోసం సహజమైన రసాయనాలు ఉపయోగించి డైపర్స్ ను తయారు చేయడం.
problem_translated: In the past, people used to apply turmeric to children's bodies because turmeric acts as an antibiotic and prevents skin itching. This was not the packaged turmeric we use today, but rather turmeric made by grinding raw turmeric rhizomes (pasupu kommulu) that they grew themselves. However, people are now using body lotions and diapers, which are causing rashes.
solution_translated: To prevent rashes on young children's bodies, create diapers using natural, chemical-free materials.
summarization: The student identifies that modern diapers and synthetic lotions are causing skin rashes in children, unlike the traditional practice of using natural, homemade turmeric. The proposed solution is to develop diapers made from natural, chemical-free materials to protect children's skin.

Problem: పశువులకు గడ్డి కోయడం లో ఇబ్బందులు

problem_translated: Difficulties in cutting grass for cattle.
solution_translated: We will cut the grass by attaching a blade to a motor.
summarization: The student identifies the challenge of manually cutting grass for livestock. To address this, they propose using a motorized blade system to automate and simplify the grass-cutting process.

Problem:
ఇంట్లో వాడేసిన వస్తువులు కాలుష్యాన్ని కలగజేస్తాయి 
 
 చలికాలంలో స్నానానికి వేడి నీరు అవసరం
Solution: ముందుగా మేము ఒక చిన్న వైరు తీసుకున్నాము.గోడలకు రంగును వేసే బ్రష్ ను తీసుకొని దానిని కొంచెం కత్తిరించి వైరును దానిలో పెట్టాము. వైరులో ఉండే జీ వైరును తీసి రెండు భాగాలు చేశాము. ఆ రెండు భాగాలను ఇనుమును గుండ్రంగా చుట్టాము. ప్లాస్టర్ దానికి అతికించాము. ఆ తర్వాత వైరుకి ప్లగ్ ను పెట్టాము. ఒక మగ్గులో నీళ్లను పోసి మేము తయారు చేసిన వాటర్ హీటర్ ఆ నీళ్లలో పెట్టి స్విచ్ ఆన్ చేశాము. 20 నిమిషాల తర్వాత హీటర్ స్విచ్ ఆఫ్ చేశాము. నీళ్లు వేడిగా మారాయి. పొగలు కూడా ఎల్లాయి.మేము ఈ ప్రాజెక్టును ఇంట్లో పనికిరాని పదార్థాలతో తయారు చేశాము. మనం మార్కెట్లో డబ్బులు పెట్టుకొని అవసరం లేకుండా ఇలా పనికిరాని పదార్థాలతో ఇంట్లో తయారు చేసుకోవచ్చు.
problem_translated: Used household items cause pollution. Hot water is needed for bathing during the winter season.
solution_translated: First, we took a small wire. We took a paintbrush used for painting walls, cut it slightly, and inserted the wire into it. We removed the 'G' wire (ground wire) from the main wire and split it into two parts. We coiled those two parts around an iron piece and secured it with tape. After that, we attached a plug to the wire. We filled a mug with water, placed our homemade water heater into the water, and switched it on. After 20 minutes, we switched off the heater. The water became hot, and steam was rising. We made this project using waste materials from home. Instead of spending money in the market, we can make this at home using these waste materials.
summarization: The student addresses the issue of household waste and the need for hot water in winter by creating a DIY water heater. By repurposing waste materials like old wires and a paintbrush, they have built a functional heating device that avoids the cost of purchasing one from the market.

solution_translated: Preparing and using a powder made from brick powder, turmeric, salt, and charcoal powder.

Problem: ఈ మంట నుండి కొంత ఉష్ణం పరిసరాల్లోకి విడుదలగుట వలన బర్నర్ పరిసరాల్లోని గాలి వంటగదిలో గాలి వేడెక్కడాన్ని మనం గమనిస్తూ ఉంటాం దీనివలన మనం చేసే వంట ఆలస్యం అవ్వడమే గాక చాలా ఎల్పిజి వృధా అవుతుంది.
Solution: బర్నర్ చుట్టూ కాపర్ ఘట్టాన్ని ఒక కాయిల్ లాగా పాత్ర నుంచుటకు ఇబ్బంది లేకుండా అమర్చవలెను ఈ కాయిల్ రెండు వైపులా ఒక ఇన్సులేటర్ వాటర్ ట్యాంకు అమర్చ వలెను ఇన్సులేటర్ ట్యాంకును స్టవ్కు దగ్గరగా, మనం వంట వండి పాత్రకు తగలకుండా అమర్చ వలెను ఇన్సులేటర్ ట్యాంకుకు ఒక టాప్ ను బిగించి వేడి నీటిని అవసరమైన వంట, ఇతర పనులలో ఉపయోగించుకోవచ్చు
problem_translated: We observe that heat released from the burner into the surroundings causes the air in the kitchen to heat up. This not only delays the cooking process but also leads to a significant waste of LPG.
solution_translated: A copper coil should be installed around the burner in such a way that it does not interfere with placing vessels on the stove. On both sides of this coil, an insulated water tank should be attached. The insulated tank should be placed close to the stove but without touching the cooking vessel. A tap should be fitted to the insulated tank so that the heated water can be used for cooking or other household purposes.
summarization: The student proposes a system to capture wasted heat from a gas stove burner by using a copper coil connected to an insulated water tank. This design prevents kitchen overheating and reduces LPG waste by repurposing the heat to warm water for domestic use.

Problem: రాత్రి పూట కరెంటు పోయినప్పుడు పిల్లలు భయపడతారు పెద్దవారికి కూడా వస్తువులు కనిపించవు అందుకోసమే ఎమర్జెన్సీ లైట్ అవసరం అవుతుంది

Problem: ಗ್ಯಾಸ್ ಸಿಲಿಂಡರ್ ಬಳಸುವಾಗ ಗ್ಯಾಸ್ ಸಿಲಿಂಡರನಲ್ಲಿ ಖಾಲಿ ಆಗುವ ಅನಿಲದ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಗೊತ್ತಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಹಾಗೂ ಅ ಅನಿಲಸೋರಿಕೆಯಾಗುವುದು ತಿಳಿಯದಿರುವುದು
Solution:
ಈ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನವು ಿಲಿಂಡರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಖಾಲಿಯಾಗುವ ಅನಿಲದ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಹಾಗೂ ಸೋರಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಅರಿಯುವಂತೆ ತಯಾರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ
 ಉತ್ಪನ್ನದ ಕಾರ್ಯವಿಧಾನ
 ಲೋಡ್ ಮೌಂಟ್ ಮೇಲೆಸಿಲಿಂಡರಿಟ್ಟಾಗ ಅದರ ಕೆಳಗಿರುವ ಲೊಡ್ ಸೇಲ್ ಒತ್ತಡವನ್ನು HX711amplifier ಗೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆಅಲ್ಲಿಂದ aurdino nano ಗೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿದರೆ ಅದು ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಸಂಕೇತಗಳಾಗಿ ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆಗೊಂಡು ಎಲ್ಸಿಡಿ ಡಿಸ್ಪ್ ಗೆ ರವಾನಿಸಿದಾಗ ಆ ಪರದೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಸಿಲಿಂಡರ್ ನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಅನಿಲದ ಪ್ರಮಾಣವನ್ನುಶೇಕಡವಾರು ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಹಾಗೂಏನಾದರೂ ಸಿಲಿಂಡರ್ ಹಾಗೂಸ್ಟೌನಿಂದ ಅನಿಲ ಸೋರಿಕೆ ಆದರೆ ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಅರಿಯುವಂತೆಈ ಉಪಕರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿರುವ ಗ್ಯಾಸ್ ಸೆನ್ಸರ್ ಆ ಅನಿಲವನ್ನು ಹೀರಿಕೊಂಡು ತಕ್ಷಣವೇ ಬಜಾರ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ ಶಬ್ದವನ್ನು ಉಂಟು ಮಾಡಿ ಎಲ್ಇಡಿ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ದೀಪ ಬೆಳಗುತ್ತದೆ ಇದರಿಂದ ಅನಿಲ ಸೋರಿಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಇದರಿಂದ ಆಗುವ ಅವಘಡವನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪಿಸಲು ಸಹಾಯಕವಾಗಿದೆ
problem_translated: When using a gas cylinder, it is difficult to know the amount of gas remaining, and gas leaks often go undetected.
solution_translated: This product is designed to easily detect the amount of gas remaining in the cylinder and identify gas leaks. Working mechanism: When the cylinder is placed on the load mount, the load cell underneath sends pressure data to the HX711 amplifier. From there, it is sent to an Arduino Nano, which converts it into electrical signals and transmits them to an LCD display, showing the percentage of gas remaining in the cylinder. Additionally, if there is a gas leak from the cylinder or the stove, a gas sensor installed in the device detects the gas and immediately triggers a buzzer sound and lights up an LED. This makes it easy to identify a gas leak and helps prevent potential accidents.
summarization: This project addresses the difficulty of monitoring gas levels and detecting leaks in cylinders. It uses a load cell with an Arduino Nano to display the remaining gas percentage on an LCD screen and incorporates a gas sensor to trigger an alarm and LED light in the event of a leak, thereby enhancing safety.

problem_translated: A floating house is a way to protect oneself during natural disasters. It is a dwelling that will be built using modern technology.

Problem: ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃಷಿ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಬೇಸಾಯ ನಮ್ಮದಾಗಿದ್ದು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಬಹುತೇಕ ಬೋರೆಲ್ ಗಳನ್ನು ಕೊರೆದಿದ್ದೇವೆ ಬೋರ್ವೆಲ್ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಕೆಟ್ಟಾಗ ಅದನ್ನು ಹೊರ ತೆಗೆಯಲು ಮೊದಲು ಜನರನ್ನ ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿದ್ದಿವಿ ಇದು ಜನರಿಗೆ ಹೊರೆಯಾಗುತ್ತಿತ್ತು ನಂತರ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಯಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ಮಷೀನ್ ತಯಾರಿಸಿದ್ದೀವಿ. ಇದು ಕರೆಂಟ್ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಇರುವಾಗ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ನಾವು ಸೈಕಲ್ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಇಂಜಿನ್ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಬೋರ್ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆತ್ತುವ ಸಾಧನವನ್ನು ತಯಾರಿಸಿದ್ದೇವೆ ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಯಾವುದೇ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ತಿನ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆ ಇಲ್ಲ ನಮಗೆ ಯಾವಾಗ ಬೇಕಾದಾಗ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಇಂಜಿನ್ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಬೋರ್ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಎತ್ತಬಹುದು
Solution: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಕೃಷಿಗೆ ನೀರಾವರಿ ಅತಿ ಅವಶ್ಯಕವಾಗಿದೆ ಆದರೆ ನೀರಾವರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೋರ್ವೆಲ್ನಿಂದ ನೀರನ್ನು ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆತ್ತುವುದು ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ ಇಂಥ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾವು ಬರವಣಿಗೆ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಮೋಟಾರನ್ನು ಅಳವಡಿಸಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಆ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಕೆಟ್ಟಾಗ ಅದನ್ನು ಹೊರ ತೆಗೆಯಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಹೊರ ತೆಗೆಯಲು ಅನೇಕ ಸಾಧನಗಳಿದ್ದರೂ ಅದು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬಳಸಬಹುದಾಗಿದೆ ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ನಾವು ತಯಾರಿಸಿದ ಈ ಒಂದು ಸಾಧನ ಒಂದು ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಮೋಟರ್ ಸೈಕಲ್ ನ ಇಂಜಿನ ವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಇದನ್ನು ಮೂರು ಕಬ್ಬಿಣದ ಕಂಬಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಲ್ಲುವ ಹಾಗೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಜೋಡಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ ಸೈಕಲ್ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ನ ಇಂಜಿನ್ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿದಾಗ ಬೆಲ್ಟ್ ನ ಸಹಾಯದಿಂದ ನಾವು ಮೊಟರನ್ನು ಮೇಲಕ್ಕೆ ಎತ್ತಬಹುದು ಮತ್ತು ಅತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇಂಧನದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾವು ಮೋಟಾರನ್ನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆತ್ತಬಹುದು ಮತ್ತು ಯಾವುದೇ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆತ್ತಬಹುದು ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಅಥವಾ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ಜನರ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆ ಇರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಇದು ಸಮಾಜಕ್ಕೆ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಉತ್ತಮ ಸಾಧನವಾಗಿದೆ
problem_translated: In our rural area, agriculture is the main occupation, and we have many borewells. Previously, when a borewell motor broke down, we had to rely on people to pull it out, which was a burden. Later, we created an electric-powered mechanical machine, but it would not work during power outages. Therefore, we have developed a borewell motor lifting device based on a motorcycle engine. It does not require any electricity; we can start the motor engine whenever we need to and lift the borewell motor.
solution_translated: Irrigation is essential for agriculture, and pulling water from borewells is necessary. When the electric motor used for this purpose breaks down, it must be removed. Although there are many tools available for this, they can only be used at specific times. The device we have created uses a small motorcycle engine attached to a structure made of three iron poles. When the motorcycle engine is started, we can lift the motor using a belt. This allows us to lift the motor at any time using very little fuel, without the need for electricity or many people. Therefore, this is an excellent device for society.
summarization: The student has developed a portable, engine-powered lifting device to remove broken borewell motors, addressing the limitations of manual labor and electricity-dependent machinery. By using a motorcycle engine and a pulley system, the device allows farmers to easily lift motors at any time without needing electricity or extra manpower.

  ಸ್ವಯಂ ಚಾಲಿತ ರೈಲ್ವೆ ಗೇಟ್ ಇದು ಸ್ವಯಂ ಚಾಲಿತವಾಗಿ ಗೇಟ್ ಹಾಕುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಹೇಗೆಂದರೆ ನಾವು ರೈಲ್ವೆ ಗೇಟ್ನಿಂದ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿದ್ದೇವೆ ಅದು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ರೈಲು ಬಂದ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಸೆನ್ಸರ್ ಸೆನ್ಸ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಅದು ರೈಲ್ವೆ ಗೇಟ್ ಹಾಕುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ನಂತರ ರೈಲು ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ದಾಟಿದ ನಂತರ ಅದರ ನಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿದ್ದ ಸೆನ್ಸರ್ ಸೆನ್ಸ್ ಮಾಡಿ ರೈಲ್ವೆ ಗೇಟ್ ತೆಗೆಯುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ಇದರಿಂದ ಗೇಟ್ ಮನ್ಗಳ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆ ಇರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಮತ್ತು ಇದು ಹಗಲು-ರಾತ್ರಿ ಎರಡು ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ರಾತ್ರಿ ವೇಳೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗೆಟ್ ಮನ್ ಗಳು ನಿದ್ದೆಗೆ ಜಾರುವ ಸಂದರ್ಭವಿತ್ತು ಆದರೆ ಇದು ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲೂ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ

problem_translated: The government faces a financial burden, and accidents occur due to the negligence of gatekeepers. Additionally, there is a need for 24/7 operation.
solution_translated: The tools used to create the automatic railway gate include an IR sensor, servo motor, Arduino board, buzzer, etc. This automatic railway gate operates by itself. We have installed sensors at a distance from the railway gate; as soon as the train arrives, the sensor detects it and triggers the gate to close. Once the train has completely passed, another sensor installed further ahead detects it and triggers the gate to open. This eliminates the need for gatekeepers. Since it operates day and night, it resolves the issue of gatekeepers falling asleep during night shifts, as it functions at all times. This model can also be implemented for parking gates and home gates. It addresses the problems caused by human error, such as gatekeepers falling asleep at night, and reduces the financial burden on the government regarding gatekeeper salaries.
summarization: The student proposes an automated railway gate system using IR sensors, an Arduino board, and servo motors to prevent accidents caused by human negligence. This system functions 24/7 without the need for gatekeepers, thereby eliminating human error and reducing the financial burden of salaries on the government. The model is versatile and can also be applied to parking and home gates.

Problem: ಕೆರೆಯ ಮಧ್ಯಭಾಗ ಅಥವಾ ನದಿಯ ಮಧ್ಯಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕಸವನ್ನು ಸ್ವಚ್ಛಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಅದನ್ನು ಸ್ವಚ್ಛಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಮಾನವನನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿದ್ದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವರ ಪ್ರಾಣ ಹಾನಿಯನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪಿಸಲು
Solution: ನಾವು ಒಂದು ಕೆರೆಗೆ ಭೇಟಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟಂತಹ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಕೆರೆಯು ಮಧ್ಯಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಹಳ ಗಲೀಜು ಆಗಿರುವುದು ಕಂಡು ಬಂತು ಅವಾಗ ನಾವು ಆ ಮಧ್ಯಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕಸವನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕಲು ಈ ಮಾದರಿಯನ್ನು ತಯಾರಿಸಿದೆವು ಈ ಬ್ಲೂಟೂತ್ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಬೋಟ್ Andriod ಫೋನ್‌ನಿಂದ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಅದು ರೋಬೋಟ್‌ಗೆ ಲಗತ್ತಿಸಲಾದ ಇತರ andriod ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಫೋನ್‌ಗೆ ಬ್ಲೂಟೂತ್ ಸಂಪರ್ಕವನ್ನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಬ್ಲೂಟೂತ್ ಸಂಪರ್ಕವು ರೂಪುಗೊಂಡ ತಕ್ಷಣ, ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದೇ ಗುಂಡಿಯನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಿದರೆ, ಒತ್ತಿದ ಬಟನ್‌ಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಕೋಡ್ ಅನ್ನು ಬ್ಲೂಟೂತ್ ಮಾಡ್ಯೂಲ್‌ನ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ತುದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ರೋಬೋಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಲಾದ ಬ್ಲೂಟೂತ್ ಸಹಾಯದಿಂದ ರೋಬೋಟ್ ಈ ಕೋಡ್ ಅನ್ನು ಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿದ ಕೋಡ್ ಅನ್ನು ಬ್ಲೂಟೂತ್ ಮಾಡ್ಯೂಲ್ HC-05 ಸಹಾಯದಿಂದ ಮೈಕ್ರೋಕಂಟ್ರೋಲರ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಂಸ್ಕರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೋಡ್ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಮೈಕ್ರೊಕಂಟ್ರೋಲರ್ಗೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೈಕ್ರೊಕಂಟ್ರೋಲರ್ ಯಾವುದೇ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ಗೆ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಮ್ ಮಾಡಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಡ್ರೈವರ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ಅದರ ನಿರ್ಧಾರವನ್ನು ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ಮೋಟಾರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಫಾರ್ವರ್ಡ್ ಅಥವಾ ಬ್ಯಾಕ್‌ವರ್ಡ್ ಚಲನೆ ಅಥವಾ ತಿರುವು ಮತ್ತು ಬಿನ್ ಮೂವ್‌ಮೆಂಟ್‌ಗೆ ಚಾಲನೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
problem_translated: To clean waste located in the middle of lakes or rivers, and to prevent the loss of human life that occurs when humans are used for such cleaning tasks.
solution_translated: When we visited a lake, we found that the middle part was very dirty. To remove the waste from the center, we created this model. This Bluetooth-based boat is controlled by an Android phone, which connects via Bluetooth to another Android mobile phone attached to the robot. Once the Bluetooth connection is established, pressing any button on the mobile app sends a corresponding code, which is received by the Bluetooth module at the other end. The robot senses this code with the help of the Bluetooth module. The received code is processed by a microcontroller with the help of an HC-05 Bluetooth module. The code number is sent to the microcontroller, which is programmed to make decisions based on the input and output commands to motor drivers. These drivers then control the motors for forward or backward movement, turning, and bin movement.
summarization: The student identified the danger and difficulty of cleaning waste from the middle of water bodies. To address this, they developed a Bluetooth-controlled robotic boat that can be operated remotely via an Android app to collect waste, thereby eliminating the need for humans to enter the water.

Problem: ಹಗಲು ಹೊತ್ತು ಸದಾ ದೀಪಗಳು ಉರಿಯುವುದರಿಂದ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ನಷ್ಟವಾಗುತ್ತಿತ್ತು
Solution: ಈ ಮಾದರಿಯನ್ನು ಸಿದ್ದಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಬಳಸಿದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಉಪಕರಣಗಳು ಎಂದರೆIC LM555 ಬೆಳಕಿನ ಕಿರಣಗಳು lDR ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿದ್ದಾಗ ಅಡೆತಡೆ ಉಂಟಾಗಿ lDR ನ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ರೋಧ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಇದರಿಂದ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ಆಗಿ ದೀಪಗಳು ಆರುತ್ತವೆ ನಂತರ ಕತ್ತಲೆಯಾದಾಗ LDR ಇ ಮೇಲೆ ಬೆಳಕು ಬಿಡುವುದು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ ಆಗ ಸರ್ಕ್ಯೂಟ್ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜಾಗಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ದೀಪಗಳು ಹತ್ತುತ್ತವೆ ಅಂದರೆ ಬೆಳಕಿದ್ದಾಗ ದೀಪಗಳು ಕತ್ತಲೆಯಾದಾಗ ತನ್ನಿಂದ ತಾನೇ ದೀಪಗಳು ಉರಿಯಲಾರಂಭಿಸುತ್ತವೆ ಇದರಿಂದ ಬೆಳಕಿನ ಅಪವೇಯ ತಪ್ಪುತ್ತದೆ
problem_translated: Electricity was being wasted because lights were left on during the daytime.
solution_translated: The main components used to prepare this model are the IC LM555. When light rays fall on the LDR, an obstruction is created, increasing the electrical resistance of the LDR, which causes the voltage to drop and the lights to turn off. When it gets dark, no light falls on the LDR, the circuit completes, the voltage increases, and all the lights turn on. In other words, the lights automatically turn off when there is light and turn on when it is dark, thereby preventing the wastage of electricity.
summarization: The student identified the issue of electricity wastage caused by lights remaining on during the day. They proposed an automatic lighting system using an IC LM555 and an LDR sensor that detects ambient light levels to switch the lights on or off, ensuring energy efficiency.

Problem: ನೀರನ್ನು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಭೂಮಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರಾವರಿ ಮಾಡುವುದರಿಂದ, ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ತೇವಾಂಶದಲ್ಲಿನ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸದಿಂದ ಸಸ್ಯಗಳು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಒತ್ತಡಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಗಾಗುತ್ತವೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಸಸ್ಯದ ನೋಟವು ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಿಸ್ಟಮ್ನ ಸ್ವಯಂಚಾಲಿತ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣದ ಅನುಪಸ್ಥಿತಿಯು ಅನುಚಿತ ನೀರಿನ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಗೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

 ಪರಿಸರ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ
 
 ಸ್ಮಾರ್ಟ್ ನೀರಾವರಿ ಪರಿಸರ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ನೀರನ್ನು ಕಾಪಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ
problem_translated: Direct irrigation of water into the soil causes plants to undergo high stress due to variations in soil moisture, which reduces the plant's appearance. The absence of an automatic control system leads to an improper water management system.

Solution:
அழுக்கான தயாரிப்பு சூழ்நிலைகள்: விவசாய மற்றும் உணவுப் பொருள் உற்பத்தியாளர் பகுதிகளில் சுகாதார நிபந்தனைகள் குறைவாக இருக்கும்போது,

 3. மாசுபாடு: pesticides, heavy metals, மற்றும் இவ்வாறான வேதியியல் பொருட்கள் உணவுப் பொருட்களில் உள்ளதால், மக்கள் உடல் நலத்திற்கு பாதிப்புகளை ஏற்படுத்தும்.
 
 
 4. உணவு போலிகள்: உணவுப் பொருட்களின் உண்மைத்தன்மையை உறுதிப்படுத்த முடியாத போது, மக்கள் மோசமான அல்லது பாதிக்கப்பட்ட உணவுகளை சாப்பிடுவார்கள்.
 
 
 5. உணவுப் பாதுகாப்பு விதிமுறைகள்: பல நாடுகளில் உணவுப் பாதுகாப்பு விதிமுறைகள் அல்லது நடைமுறைகள் குறைவாக இருக்கலாம், இதனால் பாதுகாப்பான உணவு கிடைப்பதற்கு கடினமாகிவிடுகிறது.
 
 
 6. பாரம்பரிய விவசாயம்: மூலிகை மற்றும் மரபுச்செல்வத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தாத விவசாயம், உயர் மாசுபாடு மற்றும் அழுக்கின் ஆபத்தை அதிகரிக்கிறது.
